written.headline: Nous Research releases Arete-27B after fine-tuning Alibaba model
written.summary: Nous Research fine-tuned Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B model on 53 million tokens to create Arete-27B, reducing its rate of responses containing Chinese state propaganda from 22 percent to under one percent. The startup publicly released the model weights and training data.

written.headline: GenRobot AI raises $100 million Series A+ for robot training data
written.summary: Beijing-based GenRobot AI has completed a $100 million Series A+ funding round to support its robot training data infrastructure. The financing round closed in the third quarter and was disclosed on November 2.

written.headline: Environmental groups embrace AI while warning of data center impacts
written.summary: Major environmental organizations are integrating artificial intelligence into their conservation efforts to analyze climate data and monitor wildlife. Simultaneously, these groups are raising alarms over the substantial electricity and water usage associated with AI data centers.
